summary: Frontend-only fix (no migrations, inline-safe): the per-user Modal Size (and Form Density) Options preference now reliably governs the dynamic modal width. The System Settings live preview no longer overwrites the editing admin's own resolved data-dlux-modal-size / data-dlux-form-density body attributes with the global admin default (those are the defaults for non-overriding users, not a live body preview), and the dynamic modal now re-asserts the viewer's active modal_size on open so every dialog opens at the correct width from the first frame instead of inheriting a stale value.
